items.name: Hettemåke – voksen i sommerdrakt, stående og i flukt
items.observations: Local original digitally illustrated: adult breeding Black-headed Gull with chocolate-brown hood (not black), pale eye crescents, red bill and feet, grey-backed standing adult, second adult in flight showing black flight feathers, pale wing and white leading-edge areas. Transparent image on black and white backgrounds.
items.limitations: Pedagogic stylization of summer adults, not a full seasonal identification guide. Original exists locally, binary upload to GitHub still required.
